verdict_reason: The shared caller-headers fix is in and behaves correctly, but the countries request stays copied across two tests and FaultsIT.

todos.issue: The PR rewrites one call as the same five-line restTemplate.exchange of /mdm/geo/countries with mdmCallerHeaders() in two tests here (lines 32-36 and 78-82), while FaultsIT.getFrom (FaultsIT.java:149-150, reached through getCountries) makes the same call. Moving the header into mdmCallerHeaders() left the request itself copied in two IT classes.
todos.fix: Must: one helper owns the MDM countries GET made by LatencyProfilesIT and FaultsIT, and the local copies are gone. One way: add getCountries() to IntegrationBase, taking the TestRestTemplate or sharing it there, call it from both classes and delete FaultsIT's own copy.
